name: Tsukino Ao
source: The ghost who is bound into [url=/c37509]Touma's[/url] room. She was attending a university before she died. When she was alive, she used to have a severe chronic illness that forced her to take medicine. Before Ao could finally lose her virginity to her boyfriend, she ended up having a seizure and dying.
